summary_en: All treasury shares held at reference time (stock exchange settlement with Orba Healthcare on 2026-09-01) to be cancelled. As of 2026-06-30, 279,044 treasury shares outstanding (2.66% of 10,780,000 issued shares ex-treasury). Cancellation effective 2026-09-01.
title_en: Notice on Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-21, DVx Inc. announced that its board of directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares held by the company as of the reference time (基準時) on 2026-09-01, when Orba Healthcare Holdings Inc. is expected to acquire 100% of DVx's issued shares pursuant to a stock exchange agreement signed on 2026-05-22. The cancellation will include all treasury shares held at the reference time, encompassing restricted stock awards (譲渡制限付株式) distributed to officers whose restrictions will not have been lifted by the business day before the exchange effective date, and any shares acquired in response to dissenting shareholder buyout requests under Company Law Article 785(1). As of 2026-06-30, DVx held 279,044 treasury shares (2.66% of 10,780,000 issued shares excluding treasury). Cancellation is effective 2026-09-01.
